column1: Requests where the individual died prior to MAID
Requests that resulted in a medically-assisted death

Explanatory Notes: This chart represents MAID data where the report was received by Health Canada by January 31, 2021. For 2020, this represents 7,384 MAID deaths and an overall total of 9,375 written requests. It is acknowledged that jurisdictions may report different numbers of total requests and outcomes for the various scenarios (ineligible, withdrawal, or patient died) based on their own methodology for receiving and counting requests. Refer to Data Limitations (Section 2.3) for an explanation of why referrals are not included in this table. Due to small numbers, some data have been suppressed to protect confidentiality (represented by dashes). MAID cases are counted in the calendar year in which the death occurred (i.e., January 1 to December 31), and are not related to the date of receipt of the written request. All other requests are counted in the year in which they are received. Cases of self-administered MAID are included in this table. They are not identified by jurisdiction in order to protect confidentiality.
